prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated top-performing wins in adoption redesign and home wait_info.
Adding new screens at the adoption or finish stages consistently reduced performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful, while home redesigns (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Updating home wait_info frequently generated wins (5 wins), though many tests showed no clear effect.
Finish copy (4 tests), finish layout (3 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), choose_path hints (2 tests), and choose_path new screens (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for change types with only one test or conflicting outcomes (such as finish redesigns and sign-in reordering).

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Live Rendering Milestone Status Feed: Add dynamic time estimates and rendering milestone text components to the waiting screen. (why: Home wait median is 201s (mean 2336s), and wait_info updates on home have consistently yielded wins in earlier tests.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Wait Account Authentication Order: Move sign-in after adoption certificate creation and immediately before the pet rendering waiting screen. (why: Sign in currently experiences 75.1% conversion and technical stalls; placing authentication right after adoption anchors user commitment before generation starts.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Controls & Docking Guidance: Update home_intro headline and body to give explicit instructions on finding, controlling, and interacting with the pet in the desktop tray. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets on the desktop.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Arrival Desktop Notification Prompt: Enable desktop completion notification alert on the waiting screen when rendering finishes. (why: High mean home wait time (2336s) indicates users switch away to other apps while waiting for generation.)
4: [choose_path, new_flow] Multi-Step Path Discovery Flow: Add a new path intro screen preceding choose_path to set expectations before companion path selection. (why: choose_path has a long mean completion time (514s); introducing the options beforehand prepares users for decision making.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Sign-In Reset Prevention Copy: Update sign_in body copy to clearly explain that signing in preserves pets and prevents loss across desktop app sessions. (why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or reset after signing in.)
6: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Upload Helper: Add an explicit photo quality hint on upload_photos detailing lighting and pet face alignment tips. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly, and adoption mean duration is 1017s.)

scores.note: Updating wait_info on the home screen is a proven change with +1.2% historical average lift across 16 tests.
Reordering sign-in steps has consistently shown negative returns (-0.8% avg across 5 tests).
Finish copy changes address user support tickets but historically yield minor lift (+0.3% avg).
Targeting idle wait times with notifications has shown slight negative impact in other onboarding steps.
Adding new screens or multi-step flows consistently degrades conversion (-2.4% measured).
Sign-in copy changes address support issues, though prior single test showed slight negative lift (-0.8%).
Adding helpful hints at the adoption step consistently delivers positive conversion gains (+0.6% avg).
